claims.text: Every entry of the Mahadevan-Parpola crosswalk (v2.1, 184 entries) carries, in the locator record this spec produces, an entry-level primary-source locator for its reading fields (phonetic and semantic), or a recorded locator-not-found outcome backed by a documented search (sources consulted, in order, with dates).
